What changed from the first version
Shows come from YouTube and from podcast RSS feeds. Aditya adds or removes
them (max 10) on the dashboard, no code.
Thin data fixes itself: a show with few guest episodes gets its podcast
feed attached (Apple free directory); up to 3 shows may be added.
Founders are ranked on their own, not per topic. Founders only. Media
round = same founder on 2+ shows within 30 days.
Topics are ranked by how many shows cover them at the same time (last 30
Review Gate: shortlist, dismiss, contacted, Confirmed (removes a guest
from the list), sponsored. CSV export. Sends nothing.
Fallback chain: live data → last good snapshot → demo data, labelled in a
banner. Two crons (daily, Monday). CI must pass before deploy.
Stack: Next.js on Vercel · GitHub · Neon (Postgres) · YouTube Data API v3 · Podcast RSS · Gemini Flash · Resend
